author: TavioM
quote: this game was the standard of how to do a proper first, second and third act in a story while keeping the gameplay fun. and it stayed that way for 28 years. only its own remake was the one able to dethrone it by fixing the issues common in 3D games in the 90s such as a sloppy camera and rough 3D models.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: TavioM
quote: I mean I'm sure if you're an adult, this is a great game. But as a child, I don't see how people see the appeal of this. Its actually a little troubling.

author: TavioM
quote:
making a decent golf game is not hard (PGA, all the other mario golfs, golf story). it seems the devs put their sights on trying to beat that notion no matter what.

the game would have benefited with settings for removing the “rush” segments altogether, NOT making your character move slower when carrying all the clubs, adding a fast travel option on the story mode, etc

author: TavioM
quote: Good story, tedious pace. Also as a fan of visual novels I was expecting more drawn art to help the player imagine better the important scenes such as in the ace attorney series but they just tell you most of the story through text, as if you were reading a book
game_title: Alternate Jake Hunter: Daedalus - The Awakening of Golden Jazz
